I replied to Pree in a thread on her message in #central-team. I confirmed the correction: the new inbound lane at Marrow Agrisupply is at Gate 47, not Dock 23 as she posted this morning.

I didn't save anything to the knowledge base, so the only records of Gate 47 are her message and my reply. My earlier reply in her first thread still says Dock 23, and I left it unchanged.
